explanation: The AI response failed to produce the correct set of countries based on the actual World Bank data. It included Austria, but missed France, Germany, and Slovak Republic (specifically claiming France and Germany were above 90% in 2010 when real data shows otherwise). It also hallucinated fake data values for many other countries (e.g., India 86.7% in 2010 when actual World Bank data for India in 2010 was around 7.5%), leading to a large list of incorrect excessive answers.
